title: Tekmar 274: boilers will not stage, lag boilers off or lead short-cycling
equipment: Tekmar 274 boiler control (up to four on/off boilers); the 356 is a mixing control, see the mixing tree

n1.text: Ask the tech to read the 274 display. Is a boiler target temperature shown, or does it show "- - -"?

r_nodemand.cause: The control has no requirement for heat, so it will not fire any boiler.
fix: Find where the demand is meant to come from: a tN4 device, a DHW demand or a setpoint demand.
Warm weather shutdown only applies when the DIP switch is set to Demands, and boilers still run for a DHW or setpoint demand.
Check the demand terminals and tN4 devices for the missing call.

n2.text: Is a boiler supply sensor error, a boiler alarm, or a pump / combustion air proof error showing?

options.label: Boiler supply sensor short or open

r_sensor.cause: With the boiler supply sensor faulted, the 274 stops controlling the boilers and only sends a boiler enable to the boiler aquastat or control.
fix: The control will not operate the boiler contact if Boil Minimum is set below 100 F (38 C).
Locate and repair the sensor problem per Data Brochure D 070; the message clears itself once corrected.

r_proof.cause: A proof device or a boiler alarm is stopping or holding off the stages.
fix: Pump or combustion air damper failure: the relay closed but no proof was seen before the proof delay. With a proof demand set to C.A., boilers cannot operate until the proof is present and are sequenced off if it is lost.
Boiler alarm: the supply temperature did not rise within the boiler alarm time. Clear it by holding Up and Down together for 5 seconds while viewing the message.
Check the proof device wiring and operation.

options.label: Lag boilers stay off while the lead boiler runs

n4.text: Ask the tech to check each boiler relay: shut off power, disconnect the relay wiring, power the control, press Test and check continuity across terminals 7-8, 9-10, 11-12 and 13-14. Does each relay close when its boiler symbol shows?

r_relay.cause: A relay output is not closing when the control calls for it.
fix: If the relay does not show continuity when its symbol is on (or shows continuity when it is off), the control needs service or replacement.
These are dry contacts, so test for continuity with the wiring disconnected, not for voltage.

r_delay.cause: The control is outputting correctly, so staging is limited by its settings.
fix: Stage Delay is the minimum time between firing each stage; the next stage cannot fire until it expires. It can be manual or automatic.
The Boiler Mass setting also adjusts the inter-stage delay when auto differential is used.
Check whether boiler supply is already at or near the target, or at Boil MAX (the MAX segment shows); then lag stages are not needed.
Check the Mode setting matches how the boilers are wired (for example Mode 1 is four single-stage boilers).

r_cycle.cause: On/off boilers need a differential to avoid short cycling.
fix: The boiler differential can be fixed or automatic; the automatic setting balances temperature swing against on, off and cycle times.
The boiler aquastat must be set above the 274 boiler maximum setting, otherwise the burner short cycles.
Match the Boiler Mass setting to each boiler (LO, MED or HI).

r_rot.cause: The firing order follows the rotation settings.
fix: Rotation changes the firing order when one boiler has 48 hours more run time than another, and forces it at 60 hours. The boiler with the least hours fires first.
With rotation off the order is always lowest to highest boiler.
Fixed Lead and Fixed Last DIP switches hold a boiler in first or last position. Toggling the Rotation switch off for 3 seconds resets the sequence.
